parsed.post: Significant improvement! val_bpb dropped from 1.087 to 1.060. The capacity increase from higher aspect ratio and depth is yielding great results within the 5-minute budget. Moving to Round 5 to explore stabilization through warmup and weight decay to prevent divergence as we scale further.
parsed.description: Introduce a 10% warmup ratio and 0.01 weight decay to stabilize training of the larger capacity model and improve generalization.
